statement: You are given a binary tree. The tree is given as the array tree in level order, indexed from 0: the root is tree[0], and the left and right children of the node at index i are at indices 2i + 1 and 2i + 2. null marks a position with no node, and every position below a null must be null too.
A preorder traversal visits a node first, then traverses its left subtree in preorder, then its right subtree in preorder.
Return the node values in the order a preorder traversal visits them.

examples.explanation: The root 1 has children 2 and 3; 2 has children 4 and 5; 3 has only a right child, 6. Preorder takes 1, then the whole left subtree (2, 4, 5), then the right subtree (3, 6).
40 is the left child of 20, so it is visited right after 20 and before the root's right child 30.
